title: rupicapnos longipes subsp. reboudiana
intro: Rupicapnos longipes subsp. reboudiana, commonly known as the Mediterranean monk's hood or monk's hood, is a plant species within the genus Rupicapnos. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to alleviate pain and reduce muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote sleep. The bioactive constituents of Rupicapnos longipes subsp. reboudiana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
